title: Caerlum Rising Again
author: Wren Lockridge
blurb: Jonah Fairweather, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
